issue.title: [snmp] enable-ipv6 is not added when configure net-snmp

failure.body:
**Description**
I tried to enable snmp ipv6 (add "agentAddress udp6:161" to /etc/snmp/snmpd.conf), but get the error:

`Error opening specified endpoint "udp6:161"`

I don't see `--enable-ipv6` in src/snmpd/net-snmp-5.7.3+dfsg/config.log.
Actually, `--enable-ipv6` should be added via net-snmp-5.7.3+dfsg/debian/rules if `DEB_BUILD_ARCH_OS` is `linux`. Unfortunately, DEB_BUILD_ARCH_OS seems not be recognized when build docker-snmp-sv2.gz.

**Describe the results you expected:**
It is able to enable IPv6 of SNMP
